timed_text.text: Day 23.
Today we're doing something I do with every athlete I work with.
So I want you to go somewhere most athletes never let themselves go.
Five to ten years from now — the life where the work paid off.
Think about that.
Where the goals you've been chasing actually happened.
Not a vague idea of success.
A very specific detail picture, right?
So think about this.
Where are you?
What does your surroundings look like?
What do you see?
What do you smell?
What do you hear?
What can you taste?
What are the specific things you observe that tell you?
This is it.
This is the life I built.
Sit inside that moment and feel it.
Now what it looks like, what it actually feels like.
Pride, satisfaction, gratitude — you didn't quit when it was hard.
Why is this goal significant to you?
Why does reaching this version of your life matter?
Then, rewind.
Come all the way back to today.
The goal is there.
What is one step you can take today that moves the needle?
On your screen, you'll build this visualization in your journal.
So take your time with each prompt.
This is one of the most important things we've done in this program.

cards.prompt: Time frame and goal — five to ten years from now, what have you achieved? Write the specific goal and exactly when it happens.
The environment — describe exactly where you are. What do you see, smell, hear, taste, and observe around you? Build every detail.

The feeling — you've reached it. What are the specific emotions you feel knowing you accomplished this? Describe the pride, the satisfaction, the gratitude. Why is this moment significant to you specifically?
Rewind to today. One step. What is one single thing you can do today that moves the needle toward that moment?

timed_text.text: That visualization lives in your journal. Come back to it.
The moment you just build, that's what all of this is for.
And after you finish, day 23 is complete.
